findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The accumulation of soil buildup was observed underneath the grill in the kitchen. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the soil buildup will be cleaned. Ensure that closed and tight space within the facility are monitored and cleaned on a regular basis providing smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: There was no certified food protection manager available during today’s inspection. Discussed with PIC, and PIC mentioned that the two managers present are currently enrolled in the class to get certified. The only employee that is certified had left before inspectors arrived. Ensure that at least one person with a Certify food protection manager certificate is available during operational hours at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment:
The follow was observed being stored in open cans.
1. 3 opened cans of caramel sauce being stored in the standing cooler on in the kitchen area.
2. 2 opened cans of chocolate sauce being stored under the counter in dry storage area in the kitchen.
PIC was made aware that the condiments were to be transfer to a second container other than the stainless steel cans. PIC ensure inspectors that the condiments will be transfer to secondary containers for proper storage.
Ensure that food items are not stored in the original cans after the cans have 5been opened to avoid contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The gasket on the chest freezer in the shed outside was observed to be in disrepair. The accumulation of soil was also observed on the gaskets of the cooler. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensure that the relevant repairs will be done. Ensure that The gaskets are repaired and cleaned to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Inspector observed portion cups of shredded cheese to not be date marked. Although cheese cups are prepared near-daily, PIC informed inspector that they are occasionally kept overnight. Discussed date marking options with PIC. Options include, but are not limited to: Date marking each individual cup, date marking the tray on which the cups are kept, keep a graphic such as a table on a white board to keep track of food prep dates. PIC marked trays with correct dates for the time being. Ensure that all TCS food is marked with a use-by date that is 7 days after preparation of the food product. 

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed used mop heads to be sitting in a bucket still attached to handles. Discussed storage options with PIC, such as hanging from a mop hanger, or hanging mops over the edge of the bucket. PIC moved the mops to be hung over the side of the bucket for the time being. Ensure mops are stored in a way that allows them to dry as quickly as possible.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: There is observed visible soil on the inside wall of the ice machine. The internal walls of the ice machine were cleaned and sanitized during today’s inspection. Ensure the food contact surfaces of equipment are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-904.13: The tableware at the walk up window were observed to be stored with the handles and ends of the spoons mismatched in the container. These utensils were removed during today’s inspection and all the tableware was placed inverted in the container with the handles facing up. Ensure the tableware remains stored inverted where the hands of the employees will not come into contact with the food contact surface of the utensil.
4-904.13: (A) TABLEWARE shall be protected from contamination if preset (wrapped, covered, inverted). (B) Preset maybe exposed if: unused settings are removed when consumer is seated  or settings are cleaned and SANITIZED before further use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The inside bottom shelf of the single door freezer with the chicken strips is observed to have an accumulation of breading and other food residues. Ensure this freezer is cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The outlets near the milk cooler were observed to have a visible gap where the outlet cover has pulled away from the wall. The outlets were pushed back into the wall during today’s inspection. Further repairs are necessary to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface by securely attaching the outlet covers to the wall. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
